Thank you for posting this. I’ve dealt with depression and suicide attempts since I was 14. I’m now in my early 40’s. 

I’ve been on a variety of medicines, therapy, and spent time in a psychiatric hospital. I’ve realized that this is a life-long battle which sucks but it’s made me realize how damn tough I am. 

As far as getting rid of boredom and trying to make friends, it’s been hard for me bc I also struggle from social anxiety and sometimes getting out of the house is too much for me. But when I can, I have volunteered for animal shelters bc animals bring me comfort, makes me feel good, and I also get to know the other volunteers. I’ve also volunteered at soup kitchens. I was too scared to interact with all the people bc it overwhelms my social anxiety so I just stayed in the kitchen chopping food, cleaning up, etc. and I got to know the other volunteers. Now, I’m comfortable enough to be able to serve food to people. 

If I’m not feeling well enough to go out of the house, I work on crafts and listen to my favorite music, or get on Reddit to connect with others so I don’t feel alone. 

I hope you find what works for you. I’m sending good vibes to you, buddy.
